description: Natural language processing techniques for financial text analysis including earnings call transcription, news sentiment, SEC filing parsing, and LLM-based market analysis.

techniques.name: FinBERT
techniques.description: BERT model pre-trained on financial corpus (Reuters TRC2) and fine-tuned for financial sentiment classification. Achieves state-of-the-art on FiQA and Financial PhraseBank datasets. By Dogu Araci (2019).
techniques.verification_notes: Confirmed arxiv 1908.10063. 778+ citations on Semantic Scholar. Claims of 87% accuracy on financial phrase classification need context - it achieves SOTA but specific percentage varies by dataset.

techniques.name: Loughran-McDonald Financial Lexicon
techniques.description: Domain-specific sentiment dictionary designed for financial text, addressing limitations of general-purpose sentiment lexicons. Widely used as baseline in financial NLP research.
techniques.verification_notes: Well-established lexicon in financial NLP. Still used as baseline comparison.

techniques.name: LLM-Based Financial Document Analysis
techniques.description: Using large language models (GPT-4, Claude) for financial document summarization, risk assessment, and earnings call analysis. Emerging area with rapid development.
techniques.verification_notes: Confirmed as active research area. Kim, Muhn & Nikolaev (2024) demonstrated LLM financial statement analysis outperforming human analysts.

techniques.name: SEC Filing NLP Analysis (10-Q/10-K Diff)
techniques.description: NLP-based extraction of material changes between consecutive quarterly or annual filings. Studies report 2-5% annual alpha from filing sentiment strategies.
techniques.verification_notes: Filing-based alpha strategies are documented in academic literature. Specific alpha figures vary by study and time period.
